svg.title: 15 million webservers RPS vs RAM
svg.desc: Solid lines show mean HTTP responses per second on the left axis. Dashed lines show mean peak server RAM in GiB on the right axis. Blocking Linux sockets run out of memory at 2,550,000 listening TCP sockets. All four smoltcp backends reach at least ten million listeners. At 4M and 10M listeners, TUN and TAP RPS is the average of the measured RPS and the linear interpolation between neighboring measurements. The listener count uses a log scale to 10,000 and a square-root scale above it.
